title: COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning
title_zh: COMET：面向任务无关持续视觉-语言学习的解耦蒸馏、路由与容量控制

paragraphs.en: 本文提出COMET框架，通过解耦蒸馏、路由与容量控制，实现任务无关的持续视觉-语言学习，在X-TAIL基准上验证了各组件的有效性。 Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出COMET框架，通过解耦蒸馏、路由与容量控制，实现任务无关的持续视觉-语言学习，在X-TAIL基准上验证了各组件的有效性。 诸如CLIP等视觉-语言模型（VLM）保留了零样本识别能力，但其开放世界的应用往往需要任务无关的持续学习：任务按顺序到来，过去的数据不可用，任务身份未知，且骨干网络无法重新训练。 我们认为，这一设定使VLM在超越稳定性-可塑性权衡之外，还面临三种相互耦合的压力而失效：(1) 模态一致性漂移，(2) 表示空间干扰，(3) 单任务容量不足。 我们提出COMET（协作式专家混合迁移），分别解决这三个问题，具体如下。 冻结的教师模型仅在共享的图像-文本池上提供特征参考；三重亲和蒸馏保持图像-图像、文本-文本以及图像-文本的几何结构；学生感知的跨专家蒸馏使新专家与兼容的先验专家对齐，从而让路由错误实现优雅退化。 我们设计COMET使容量与推理相互分离：上下文老虎机利用训练后信号保留或合并完整的单任务专家，而重构路由器在测试时选择稀疏专家，无需教师语义。 在X-TAIL基准上，我们展示了所提出的每个组件都能提升持续学习性能。 COMET表明，当特征参考、专家塑形、路由与容量控制在结构上相互分离时，持续视觉-语言适配能够保持多模态几何结构、协调累积的专家并联合分配容量。
